description: The Maelstrom's Tendril Level 60 Even from here I can hear the sound of your volleys laying waste to our enemies. Their cries echo in agony. You have made quite a name for yourself among the trolls of Zandalar, <name>. We are grateful for all that you have done. Hand me your talisman so that I may add another weave. Requirements: - Maelstrom's Tendril
